title: CustomizeChat
description:
A Plugin For Chat and Custom Join/Leave Message
A Custom Chat Format
New Plugin
body:
- In This Plugin You Can Set Custom Join/Leave Messages.
- You Can Set Custom Chat Format

config.yml:

```
# <player> = player name
# <message> = player message
# <prefix> = player prefix
# this plugin support MiniMessages

messages:
  join: "<green>[+] <white><player>"
  leave: "<red>[-] <white><player>"
  format: "<prefix><player> <gold>: <white><message>"
```
